entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet-watch` support for mobile #52492
  • openSUSE 16 / SLES 16: .NET 8 installation fails due to OpenSSL dependency mismatch #52490
  • Missing .NET SDK packages for Debian 12/13 arm64 #52489
  • 10.0.102 Breaks at least macs with workloads that aren't available.` #52483
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #52482
  • `dotnet run app.cs` incorrectly pushes `app.cs` as `args[0]`, which is different to how arguments are normally handled #52494
  • [NETSDKE2E]With 10.0.200-preview sdk zip, .NET workloads throw “Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WorkloadManifestReader.WorkloadManifestCompositionException” when run `dotnet --info`. #52478
  • MSB4018 IOException cannot access the file because it is being used by another process #52477
  • Review net 11 TFM update for opportunities for improvement of SDK codebase #52474
    11.0.1xx

Closed

  • Error reading git repository information: Unsupported repository extension 'relativeworktrees'. Only noop, preciousObjects, partialclone, worktreeConfig are supported. #52493
    10.0.2xx
  • 'dotnet run file.cs' tries/fails to find the ILCompiler for the non-portable rid. #52395
  • Publishing native AOT fails on Fedora 40, Documentation suggests packages only for Ubuntu #42335
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Missing workload packages #52457
  • The browser is stuck with error "WebSocket connection to 'wss://localhost:65041/' failed:" after dotnet watch for Blazor Web App ~ Server ~Global #52293
